verdict.rationale: Pipeline CRM documents an integrations page with named prebuilt connectors, including Mailchimp for marketing, Zapier and QuickBooks, and refers to off-the-shelf connectors. Its Pipeline Connect offering is a vendor-built, done-for-you service, not self-serve installation from a marketplace. missing for 10: an evidenced app marketplace or self-serve install flow, Slack integration, support-desk integration, data-warehouse integration, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can install prebuilt integrations (Slack, support desk, marketing, data warehouse) from an app marketplace

citations.quote: Connects with Gmail, Outlook, QuickBooks, Mailchimp, Apollo, Zapier, and more
including tools with no off-the-shelf connector
